attributes.name: Strength
attributes.desc: Raw power. Melee damage, carry weight, heavy shields.

attributes.name: Endurance
attributes.desc: Toughness. Hit points, resistance to poison and sickness, recovery.

attributes.name: Agility
attributes.desc: Speed and coordination. Action points, defense, sneaking.

attributes.name: Perception
attributes.desc: Senses. Ranged accuracy, who acts first, noticing what others miss.

attributes.name: Wits
attributes.desc: Learning and cunning. Skill points per level, lore, sharper things to say.

attributes.name: Presence
attributes.desc: Bearing and charm. Speech, barter, how strangers take you at first sight.

attributes.name: Fortune
attributes.desc: The favor of the gods. Critical hits, strange encounters, luck at dice.

skills.name: Spears
skills.desc: Thrusting spears and polearms. Reach from the second rank.

skills.name: Brawling
skills.desc: Fists, knees, heads. Also clubs and staves.

skills.name: Shield
skills.desc: Catching blows on a shield instead of your body.

skills.name: Steal
skills.desc: Taking from pockets and purses, or putting things in them.

skills.name: Traps
skills.desc: Finding, setting and disarming snares, pits and spikes.

skills.name: Healing
skills.desc: Herbs, poultices and bandages. Quick help on the field.

skills.name: Surgery
skills.desc: Deep wounds, broken bones, fevers. Slow and serious.

skills.name: Gambling
skills.desc: Dice and knucklebones, Roman or Gallic.

skills.name: Lore
skills.desc: Gods, sacred places, plants, omens, and Gaulish written in Greek letters.

skills.name: Latin
skills.desc: Speaking and reading the conqueror's tongue.

skills.name: Survival
skills.desc: Travel, foraging, weather, tracks, and not being ambushed.

_kill_shock: Morale shock to a dead man's faction-mates; more if he led them. Unhurt men only test once their morale is down to 40, so a leader's fall shakes hired men and outlaws but not soldiers.
_escape_radius: In a fight, the player escapes off an exit hex if no enemy is this close.
_companion_presence_div: How many followers Presence allows: PRE divided by this, at least one. Pets don't count.
_ally_join_radius: Allies (friendly bands, not companions) join a fight that starts this close to the player, or that they can see.
_guest_bond: Breaking the guest-bond: attacking host or guest under a roof the map declares, or a dialogue `violate`. Honor, and standing with the host's people.

traits.name: Once Sold
traits.desc: You were a slave and bought your freedom. +15 Latin, +10 Barter. Romans and slavers know the brand; Gallic nobles look down on you.

traits.name: Raised in the Grove
traits.desc: A druid's foster child. +15 Lore, +10 Healing. Shedding blood in a sacred place costs you dearly.

traits.name: Champion's Pride
traits.desc: +3 melee damage. You can't refuse a challenge to single combat without losing Honor, and your Speech suffers from it (-10).

traits.name: Born in the Saddle
traits.desc: You travel a quarter faster across the land. On foot and in a fight you are clumsier: -1 action point.

traits.name: Hostage-Bred
traits.desc: You grew up as a hostage among the Arverni. +10 Speech, and the Arverni treat you as kin. Your own people trust you less.

traits.name: Gods-Touched
traits.desc: The gods are watching, and they are bored. Critical hits are three times as likely, and so are critical failures.

perks.name: Toughened
perks.desc: +4 hit points per level from now on, retroactively.

perks.name: Shield Wall
perks.desc: +10 Shield, and allies beside you share half your shield bonus.

perks.name: Bard's Friend
perks.desc: Your renown grows half again as fast, and the bards are kinder.

perks.name: Knows the Fords
perks.desc: +20 Survival; fewer ambushes on the road.

perks.name: Head-Taker
perks.desc: When you kill an enemy, every other enemy who sees it must test their nerve.

perks.name: Speaks Like a Roman
perks.desc: +25 Latin. Romans treat you as one of the better sort of provincial.
